_doc: Code hooks: located in the EBOOT by masked instruction pattern ('word/mask'), index = which instruction in the pattern is hooked. kind 'value': after the instruction runs, rt = rt_hookval(c, id, rt). kind 'call': the jal at that instruction calls rt_hookcall(c, id, original_target) instead. kind 'entry': the function starting at that instruction becomes a thunk that calls rt_hookcall(c, id, original_body). Handlers are in runtime/game.c.

hooks.name: COPTER_LIFT_DT
hooks._doc: Tail Copter: each flap sets the lift time to dt * 4 (4 frames) and accelerates at 30/s while it lasts, so above 30 fps the climb shrank. The lift time is computed from at least 1/30 s, as on the PSP.

hooks.name: SIG_START_DT
hooks._doc: Signature move start (Tails' Tail Copter among others): lift time dt * 4 and an upward kick of 2 * dt * 30, both meant as 4 frames / one frame at 30 fps. Fed at least 1/30 s.

hooks.name: RACER_MOVE
hooks._doc: A racer's move step (racer, dt): pos += vel * dt, then the collide-and-slide pass. Above ~165 fps the steps get so short that a racer sliding into a concave corner (the bottom of a loop, a ramp into a wall) creeps toward it forever instead of crossing onto the next surface; see racer_move() in game.c.

hooks.name: BUILD_RACER_SLOT
hooks._doc: Race load: the call that builds a racer slot's scene nodes (once per racer, slots 14 and 15). Experimental extra racer: SR2_EXTRA_RACER=file (a racer file from tools/racergen.py) is loaded and built here too, right after the last racer.

hooks.name: TRACK_ENTITY_SECTION
hooks._doc: World update, per entity: finds the level section it is in and switches it off when that section is not loaded; the two racers (W+0x502C[0..1]) are exempt. The experimental extra racer is exempted too.

hooks.name: RACER_INPUT
hooks._doc: A racer's input step (input): reads the pad (source 0..3, all the same pad device at 0x089A4020) or zeros (negative source) into the racer's input. The experimental extra racer gets source 1, which reads player 2's pad through a second pad device.

hooks.name: CAMERA_UPDATE
hooks._doc: The race camera's per-frame step (camera, dt): follows the racer at camera+0x294. Split view runs it a second time on the second camera's state.

hooks.name: WORLD_DRAW
hooks._doc: Race render: draws the level and racers from the current camera (F_15a460(world)). Split view draws it once per view, each clipped to its part of the screen.

hooks.name: SHADOW_DRAW
hooks._doc: Race render, after the world: F_31300 draws from the current camera too. Split view draws it once per view.

hooks.name: EFFECT_DRAW
hooks._doc: Race render, after the world: F_30414 draws from the current camera too. Split view draws it once per view.

hooks.name: RACER_STEP
hooks._doc: World update: a seated racer's frame step (F_b2e48(racer)), called for W+0x502C[0] then [1]. Extra racers without a seat are stepped right after the last seated one.

hooks.name: RACE_STATE
hooks._doc: Race state change (F_592cc(race, state): countdown, go, finish...). It acts on the two seated racers only (F_3731c), mostly by sending them events; extra racers without a seat get the events the local player gets (HOOK_SEND_EVENT) and its +0x548 timer.

hooks.name: SEND_EVENT
hooks._doc: Send an event (F_16c388(manager, target, source, hash, ...)). See RACE_STATE.

hooks.name: HUD_DRAW
hooks._doc: Race render, after the frame's 3D lists are closed: the HUD (F_12ad44(0x08A7DF30)), drawn with a 2D projection through the viewport. Split screen draws it once per view.

hooks.name: RING_PICKUP
hooks._doc: F_16b90(rings, racer): the rings a racer touches this frame (a section's ring list; returns how many it took).

hooks.name: HUD_ELEM
hooks._doc: F_12f280(element): draws one HUD element (its +0xA0 says whether it is shown).

hooks.name: HUD_PART_A
hooks._doc: F_12d868: a HUD part drawn by F_12ad44.

hooks.name: HUD_PART_B
hooks._doc: F_130ab8: a HUD part drawn by F_12ad44.

hooks.name: HUD_PART_C
hooks._doc: F_12dfa4: a HUD part drawn by F_12ad44 (for the rival).

hooks.name: HUD_PART_D
hooks._doc: F_1276b0: a HUD part drawn by F_12ad44.

hooks.name: PLAYER_CONTACTS
hooks._doc: World update (F_15aafc): F_15c2d0(world), the local player's (world +0x5024) contacts with the ground and the level's objects, which drive its actions and animation. Extra racers get their own pass.

hooks.name: FOCUS_RACER_STEP
hooks._doc: World update (F_15aafc): F_15e4a8(world, world +0x5028), a step for the racer the world follows (player 1).

hooks.name: RACER_UPDATE
hooks._doc: F_af53c(racer, ...): a racer's update in the world update (rings, animation). Extra racers run it as the local player (test).

hooks.name: RACER_FINISH
hooks._doc: F_b2530(racer): a racer crosses the finish line (sets race state 7, the race is over).

hooks.name: SLOT_ACTIVE
hooks._doc: F_160724(world, slot): whether a load slot is live (section slots near the player; 14, 15 and 63 always). Gates sounds and effects of what is in the slot; the extra racers' slots count as live.

hooks.name: ENTITY_HANDLE
hooks._doc: F_15f84(entity): an entity's handle (load slot, pool index), which F_15e8c turns back into the entity. Slots 14 and up share slot 0's pools; an extra racer's body is in slot 0's pool but says slot 13-11, so its handle is made as for slot 15.

hooks.name: VOICE_PICK
hooks._doc: F_126efc(voice, kind, ...): a racer's voice object (racer+0x4ec) picks a random line of that kind to say.

hooks.name: MENU_GOTO
hooks._doc: F_14cb34(menus, hash, transition): the menus (0x08A842BC) go to the screen with that hash.

hooks.name: BANTER_CHECK
hooks._doc: F_81944(mode): whether the race opens with the two racers' camera shots and lines (story races).

hooks.name: WORLD_RACER
hooks._doc: F_3731c(world, i): i 1 the local player, 0 the other racer.

hooks.name: STORY_PROGRESS
hooks._doc: F_13a63c(profile): the furthest any character has got in story mode (a stage id, 255 none), which unlocks zones and acts in Single Event. Test aid: SR2_UNLOCK_ALL=1 answers 255 (everything open).

hooks.name: BOSS_INIT
hooks._doc: A boss's start (F_c0044(boss), shared by the six bosses' classes): it takes its two contenders, the local player (+0x6d0, hits at byte +0x6d4) and the other racer (+0x6dc, hits at +0x6e0).

hooks.name: BOSS_HIT
hooks._doc: F_c0164(boss, racer): the racer hit the boss. Only the two contenders count; the first to the boss's number of hits (vt+0x158, 6) wins. Players 3 and 4 have hit counts of their own, swapped in as the local player's while their hit is counted.

hooks.name: BOSS_MOST_HITS
hooks._doc: F_c0d30(boss): the most hits either contender has, which sets how hard the boss fights. With players 3 and 4 it is the most of anyone's.

hooks.name: BT_START
hooks._doc: F_80ec4(battle): a battle room's start (its rules object's init for the mode, the rival the computer's). The extra players get their own scores from here.

hooks.name: BT_RESTART
hooks._doc: F_80fa8(battle): the battle again from the start (Retry): the rules object's reset.

hooks.name: BT_UPDATE
hooks._doc: F_81080(battle, f12 = dt): the battle's frame, the rules object's update (slot 6): who wins and when. Players 3 and 4's King of the Hill time and Tag time are counted here.

hooks.name: BT_SCORE
hooks._doc: F_812a0(battle, racer, kind): the score of that racer (slot 11), by its index: the local player 1, the other racer 0, anyone else -1.

hooks.name: BT_PARAM
hooks._doc: F_813c8(battle, racer, a2, a3): the rules' slot 9 for that racer.

hooks.name: BT_EVENT13
hooks._doc: F_814f4(battle, racer, kind): slot 13 for that racer: Knock Out's knock-out, Laps Race's lap.

hooks.name: BT_EVENT14
hooks._doc: F_81610(battle, racer, a2): slot 14 for that racer.

hooks.name: BT_EVENT12
hooks._doc: F_81730(battle, racer, kind): slot 12 for that racer: King of the Hill's on the hill, Tag's is it.

hooks.name: BT_EVENT
hooks._doc: F_81858(battle, racer, event, a3): the rules' event handler (slot 10) for that racer: Tag's tagged (11), Capture the Chao's picked up and brought home (14 to 17).

hooks.name: HUD_UPDATE
hooks._doc: F_129380(hud, f12, f13 = dt): the HUD's frame (the scores it shows, the heads of the local player and the other racer by F_3731c). In a battle with players 2-4 it runs once more per view, as that view's player.

hooks.name: CTC_BASE
hooks._doc: F_103fc0(base, racer): Capture the Chao: a racer at a base brings its Chao home if the base is its own (+0x1a8, one each for the local player and the other racer). Players 3 and 4 can bring theirs to either base.

hooks.name: STREAM_SECTION
hooks._doc: Level streaming (F_15f97c, from the world update): F_15e0e8(world, world +0x5028) gives the section the streamed window of four (one behind, two ahead) is kept around. With players 2-4 it is picked from every player's section (see stream_pick in game.c).

hooks.name: STREAM_BUSY
hooks._doc: Level streaming (F_15f97c): F_1604ec(world, focus racer) holds the window while that racer is still inside the current section's box; with players 2-4 the window follows the section picked for everyone instead.

hooks.name: SOUND_PLAY_AT
hooks._doc: F_d120(sound, owner, position, ...): plays a sound at a place (voices from F_127080 among others); test trace.

hooks.name: RACER_OPPONENT
hooks._doc: F_b1924(racer): the racer it races against (the other seat, else the local player); the computer driver eases off or pushes by how far along it is against this one. The experimental smarter computer players race the leader instead.

hooks.name: RACER_PACE
hooks._doc: F_b1a84(racer): the computer driver's pace against its opponent (F_b1924), into racer+0x8dc: 2 well behind (pushes), 1 well ahead (eases off), 0 neither. The experimental smarter computer players never ease off.

hooks.name: STREAM_WANT_CLEAR
hooks._doc: Level streaming loads (F_15e4a8): the loop clearing its list of wanted sections (the current one and its first two neighbours, 3). With players 2-4 a section lists three neighbours (stream_links in game.c) and the list holds 4.

hooks.name: STREAM_WANT_PICK
hooks._doc: Level streaming loads (F_15e4a8): the loop picking the nearest wanted section not loaded yet, over 3 (4 with players 2-4, see STREAM_WANT_CLEAR).
